# AI Gateway — knowledge

## decision
- [Converge on Praxis as the AI data plane](/components/ai-gateway/knowledge/decision-praxis-convergence.md) — Binding decision to replace Envoy's AI application layer with Praxis — one router, one policy plane, one configuration authority for AI traffic. IPP, OGX agentic runtime, ITS orchestration, and Semantic Router capabilities converge into Praxis filters.

## fact
- [AI Gateway execution risks — Llama Stack bridge and SGLang/vLLM divergence](/components/ai-gateway/knowledge/fact-ai-gateway-execution-risks.md) — Two execution risks flagged at the AI Gateway F2F beyond the six binding architecture decisions — a dual-track maintenance burden and a possible vLLM ecosystem fork.
- [AI Gateway overview](/components/ai-gateway/knowledge/fact-ai-gateway-overview.md) — Red Hat's AI-native proxy/gateway for all AI traffic — Praxis runtime, transitioning from Envoy, backing MaaS with inference routing, agentic orchestration, API translation, guardrails, and credential management.
- [AI Gateway team structure and delivery model](/components/ai-gateway/knowledge/fact-ai-gateway-team.md) — First networking org team with direct AI BU responsibility — cross-org matrixed delivery (AI Gateway team + MaaS + Agentic API + RHCL/Kuadrant + llm-d), Praxis upstream with CNCF sandbox planned, kicked off July 6 2026.
- [AI Gateway / Inference Gateway](/components/ai-gateway/knowledge/fact-ai-gateway.md) — The unified gateway for all AI traffic (inference, tool calling, A2A, egress) — distinct from MCP Gateway, architecture decided April 2026.
- [AI Gateway 3.6 scope and delivery plan](/components/ai-gateway/knowledge/fact-praxis-3-6-scope.md) — 3.6 engineering goal — Praxis replaces IPP and provides Responses support, both aiming GA quality; Messages API, API translation, guardrails, credential management; ext_proc attachment over OSSM 3.4; EA1/EA2 verification gates; TP as fallback.
